note: WP4b development contract. The geometry is read from LUCiD's own config/WCTE_geom_config.json at the pinned revision (author decision 2026-10-17); local tests use a schema-identical synthetic fixture generated by jepa_noise.lucid_bombs.from_synthetic. The readout is the merged PMT reference response (configs/lucid_pmt/reference.json, PMT R-5) with a fixed per-module parity charge gain, a fixed digit timing-width factor and dark counts OFF. No result from this config is reportable; the 2026-10-17 frozen yields/F1/F2/F3 decisions are superseded_pending_merged_readout.
readout_note: readout_dark_off: the anchor's dark-window draw and the private dark noise are not physical until the PMT R-6 SHA lands; no dark counts are drawn and none may be reported.

fixed_response.module_index: dense mPMT module index: response_manifest.module_groups(mpmt_id) over the sparse WCTE ids (0..105 with id 45 absent), never a raw mpmt_id
fixed_response.twin_policy: present in the measured readout and in the nominal twin (detector response); the twin cancels only the injected F1/F3 gains
fixed_response.note: the charge gain multiplies the expected charge per PMT (measured and twin); the timing-width factor multiplies the digit Gaussian width tts_sigma_ns per PMT

superseded_decisions.reason: frozen before the merged PMT reference response; the author has not frozen replacements
superseded_decisions.refreeze_condition: the §3.5.3a check re-run on the merged readout (F3 marginalised, dark off)

geometry.note: id 45 absent; pmt_id_in_mpmt is 1-based. Nothing is redistributed; the file is read on the host only.

lambda0_note: placeholder: the runbook fixes F2's form but not lambda0, and the PMT reference fixture has absorption off

F1.superseded_note: eligible/excluded spreads come from the 2026-10-17 pre-merge check

F3.superseded_note: r12_status from the pre-merge check; F3 is now marginalised, not known

F2.superseded_note: selected_spread 0.5 from the pre-merge check; F2-vs-F2' awaits the merged-readout re-run

F2p.superseded_note: not selected before the merge; re-decided with F2 on the merged readout

yield_range_decision.superseded_reason: frozen on 2026-10-17 before the merged PMT reference response; Y_lo/Y_hi must be re-derived by the §3.5.3a check on readout_dark_off before use
yield_range_decision.y_lo_basis: median 200.5 hit PMTs at Y_lo (hit fraction 0.1005)
yield_range_decision.y_hi_basis: hit_fraction_0.95 bound (median 0.9499; the 300 PE bound would allow 846767.8)
yield_range_decision.decision_rerun_note: v2 adds the F2-branch f1_joint evidence (105 per-module joint F1/F2 ceilings); decisions identical to v1, ceilings shifted by <=0.0013
yield_range_decision.module_index_convention: f1_joint rows are indexed by dense position 0..104; map to mpmt_id through DetectorGeometry.module_ids (id 45 absent) - never assume position == mpmt_id

event_id_source: v3 §6 WP5 integer ranges, lucid/ namespace prefix
robustness_id_note: v3 §6 has no robustness range; 220000-229999 is a WP4b extension and is reported to the lead

detectability.v_dark_source: v_dark = lambda_dark*(1+sigma_spe^2) with lambda_dark = 0 (readout_dark_off): the merged reference response declares dark_counts off, so the earlier 4200 Hz value 0.004578 PE^2 is superseded_pending_merged_readout and must not be used for a reported ceiling
detectability.f3_source: F3 is a random per-PMT gain, not known: it is marginalised by adding s_p^2 * mu_p^2 per PMT (the §3.5.6 mae_chi2 covariance term) with s_p the spread in force (lb.F3_SPREAD = 0.10)
